_comment: Maps a Slack user ID to the GitHub login it is allowed to act as when approving or rejecting the gitops PR gate. Not a secret: Slack user IDs are not sensitive, but the list itself is the entire authorization boundary for this service, so it is reviewed like any other access-control change. Find a Slack user ID via that person's profile > 'Copy member ID'. The three logins below are exactly the required_reviewers already configured on every service repo's 'prod' GitHub Environment (gh api repos/MicroTodoSuite/<repo>/environments), so this list does not grant anyone new authority -- it only lets an already-authorized reviewer act through Slack instead of the GitHub UI.
